blocks.task_summary: Find the speed of the helicopter from its position vector.
method_path: Recognize speed is magnitude of velocity vector

evidence.basis: recognition that the speed is the magnitude of the velocity (M1); speed = sqrt(4^2 + 10^2 + (-25)^2) = sqrt(741) = 107.703... = 108 (km/h) A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the angle of descent β in degrees.
method_path: Use horizontal speed from part (a) and vertical descent rate 16 km/h
Compute tan β = 16 / (horizontal speed) or use vector angle methods
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: angle between velocity vectors (10, -25, -4) and (10, -25, 0) using dot product
METHOD 3: angle between velocity vector and horizontal plane using sin β = 4 / sqrt(741)

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempt to use right-angled triangle with horizontal speed (M1); tan β = 16 / sqrt(741) (A1); β = 8.45° A1. METHOD 2: attempt to find angle between vectors (M1); cos β = 725 / sqrt(741*725) (A1); β = 8.45° A1. METHOD 3: attempt to find angle between vector and horizontal plane (M1); sin β = 4 / sqrt(741) (A1); β = 8.45° A1.
